name: Vectali
original_description:
Turn an existing logo, icon or illustration into a vector file you can resize for your website, design work or print handoff. Attach your image and choose SVG, PDF, EPS or DXF.

Compare the original and vector in an interactive preview, zoom in on details, and try light, dark or checkerboard preview backgrounds. Download another format or refresh a saved link without using another conversion credit. Preview controls do not edit the artwork.

Works with PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF and BMP. Requires a connected Vectali account with available API credits.

Upload the original image at up to 4 megapixels (4,000,000 pixels total), for example 2,000 × 2,000. Files must also be no larger than 10 MiB and 4,096 pixels per side. Animated GIF and WebP use the first frame. Check small lettering, gradients and fine detail after conversion. EPS uses a white background. DXF contains outlines; check scale and duplicate edges before cutting. Exact recovery of original vector paths is not guaranteed.

app_description: Convert uploaded PNG and JPEG logos, icons and illustrations into scalable SVG files for design work. Download the SVG, retrieve saved results, and check your remaining conversion allowance. Requires a Vectali account with API access. Connecting does not purchase a plan. Inputs are limited to 10 MiB and 262144 pixels. Fine lettering, gradients and complex artwork can need cleanup; exact reconstruction of original vector paths is not guaranteed.
